models.name: Ensemble (stacked)
models.description: Logistic stack of every model below, refit walk-forward each week. Weights depend on how each model has done out of sample, and on how much the models disagree.

models.name: Market (closing line)
models.description: De-vigged moneyline. Picks the betting favorite; the bar every model has to beat.

models.name: Elo (QB-adjusted)
models.description: 538-style Elo with a quarterback adjustment, home field and rest.

models.name: Kalman ratings
models.description: State-space team ratings that drift week to week; separate offense and defense.

models.name: Gradient boosting
models.description: LightGBM on ~60 team and matchup features (EPA, success rate, pressure, injuries).

models.name: EPA logistic
models.description: Regularized logistic regression on decayed EPA/play splits.

models.name: Personnel
models.description: Snap-weighted player value of who is actually active (QB, OL, pass rush, secondary).

models.name: Situational
models.description: Rest, travel, time zones, divisional familiarity, weather and lookahead spots.

models.name: Neural net
models.description: Small multilayer perceptron on the same features as the GBM.
